critical_signals.title: Entresto US generics erode a blockbuster: Q2 sales down 51% cc
critical_signals.what_happened: Entresto sales collapsed in Q2 2026 following US generic entry that began end of July 2025 after the Federal Circuit lifted the injunction.
critical_signals.evidence: Entresto Q2 2026 sales USD 1.181B, down 51% in constant currencies reflecting US generic competition.
critical_signals.ai_hypothesis: The steep, sustained decline signals Novartis is deprioritizing Entresto promotional spend and reallocating field, content, and MLR capacity toward priority launch brands rather than defending an eroding asset.
critical_signals.so_what: A once-core franchise is now a declining tail requiring rapid ramp-down of promotional infrastructure while budget shifts to growth brands.
critical_signals.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Creates demand to sunset Entresto omnichannel/MedComm assets efficiently and redeploy freed budget; Company can run content-retirement and MLR-archive workstreams while positioning for growth-brand reallocation.
critical_signals.next_best_action: Pitch a launch-portfolio reallocation workshop: retire Entresto assets and stand up omnichannel capacity for Kisqali, Kesimpta, Pluvicto and new approvals.
critical_signals.if_no_action: Entresto-linked content and field scope runs off on the generic curve while the reallocated budget lands with partners already attached to Kisqali, Kesimpta and Pluvicto.
critical_signals.why_now: Q2 2026 prints Entresto down 51% cc; the promotional wind-down and budget rotation are being planned this quarter.
critical_signals.nba_outcome: A signed reallocation workshop that names each Entresto workstream's retirement date and its growth-brand successor.
critical_signals.expected_outcome: Entresto assets archived under MLR rules and freed capacity redeployed to priority-brand programs within two quarters.

critical_signals.why_it_matters_to_indegene: RLT launches need specialized HCP/patient education, referral-network omnichannel, MedComm and MLR at speed; Company can own the launch-readiness build ahead of a Q3 decision.

critical_signals.if_no_action: The Q3 decision lands with no approved education assets, and the ~75% larger eligible pool finds sites and referrals through competitors' toolkits.
critical_signals.why_now: The Q3 2026 FDA decision is weeks away; pre-approval content must be built and MLR-cleared before the label expansion.
critical_signals.nba_outcome: A launch-readiness sprint scoped and staffed ahead of the Q3 decision.
critical_signals.expected_outcome: Education, omnichannel and MLR assets approved and staged for launch day, with site and referral programs ready for the expanded pool.

growth_signals.title: USD 23B US manufacturing/R&D expansion with coast-to-coast RLT network
growth_signals.what_happened: Novartis is investing USD 23B in US manufacturing and R&D, including a five-site radioligand-therapy network.
growth_signals.evidence: Seventh new US facility in Morrisville, NC, a 56,200-sq-ft API site for solid dosage and RNA therapeutics; five-site RLT network coast-to-coast.
growth_signals.ai_hypothesis: Building out RLT and RNA manufacturing signals Novartis is scaling supply for Pluvicto expansion and Avidity assets, presaging major commercial launches.
growth_signals.so_what: Supply-side investment foreshadows the commercial scale Novartis expects from RLT and RNA franchises.
growth_signals.why_it_matters_to_indegene: US-centric RLT/RNA scale-up will drive US HCP engagement, site enablement, and patient-education demand aligned to Company omnichannel and MedComm.
growth_signals.next_best_action: Align engagement proposals with the US RLT/RNA build-out and the growing eligible-patient base.
growth_signals.if_no_action: US RLT and RNA scale-up drives HCP engagement and site enablement budgets that competitors serving the build-out claim first.
growth_signals.why_now: The USD 23B investment and five-site RLT network are being stood up now; US engagement planning follows supply.
growth_signals.nba_outcome: Engagement proposals aligned to the US RLT and RNA build-out.
growth_signals.expected_outcome: US site-enablement and HCP-education programs scoped ahead of the expanded eligible-patient base.

risk_signals.title: Entresto generics launched after Novartis lost injunction bid
risk_signals.what_happened: US generic Entresto launched in late July 2025 after Novartis failed to block it despite litigation.
risk_signals.evidence: Federal Circuit lifted the injunction July 22, 2025; with pediatric exclusivity expired, multiple generic Entresto launched end of July.
risk_signals.ai_hypothesis: The failed defense confirms rapid, irreversible erosion, forcing an accelerated pivot of commercial resources off Entresto.
risk_signals.so_what: Legal defeat locks in the revenue loss and accelerates promotional wind-down.
risk_signals.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Confirms budget and field-force reallocation away from Entresto; Company can manage the asset sunset and redeploy capacity to growth brands.
risk_signals.next_best_action: Advise on Entresto commercial wind-down and rapid reallocation to priority-brand programs.
risk_signals.if_no_action: The wind-down happens in-house or with whoever is already inside the brand, while the reallocated budget moves to growth brands without Company attached.
risk_signals.why_now: Generics have been live since late July 2025 and Q2 2026 confirms 51% erosion; the pivot off Entresto is current.
risk_signals.nba_outcome: A commercial wind-down and reallocation advisory engagement.
risk_signals.expected_outcome: Entresto scope deliberately run off on a named timeline and the freed capacity redirected to priority brands.

risk_signals.title: USD 11B bond raise adds leverage to fund M&A wave
risk_signals.what_happened: Novartis issued USD 11B in bonds to finance the Avidity acquisition amid a broader dealmaking spree.
risk_signals.evidence: Novartis sold USD 11B of investment-grade bonds, maturities three to 30 years, to fund the Avidity acquisition.
risk_signals.ai_hypothesis: Debt-funded M&A raises the pressure to realize acquired-asset value quickly, sharpening focus on efficient integration and fast launch execution.
risk_signals.so_what: Financing the pipeline via debt heightens the need to convert acquisitions into revenue rapidly.
risk_signals.why_it_matters_to_indegene: Pressure to monetize acquired assets favors partners who accelerate integration and launch; Company can speed commercialization of acquired pipelines.
risk_signals.next_best_action: Position rapid launch-integration services for acquired assets (Avidity, Anthos, Tourmaline, Excellergy, Kate).
risk_signals.if_no_action: Acquired pipelines stall on slow integration while debt-service pressure mounts, and the launch-integration work goes to partners already on the deals.
risk_signals.why_now: The USD 11B raise and Avidity close are recent; integration and launch planning for acquired assets is underway.
risk_signals.nba_outcome: Rapid launch-integration services positioned across the acquired portfolio.
risk_signals.expected_outcome: Named integration workstreams on acquired assets with time-to-launch compressed against the financing timeline.
